newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Premiers Conference underway in Canberra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Premiers Conference underway in Canberra.

text.p: Australia's Premiers Conference, an annual fiscal meeting between federal and state governments, got underway in Canberra at 0930 AEDT on Friday (Thursday 2330 GMT).
The federal government, aiming for further budget cuts this year, is expected to reduce the amount of money it gives to the states for specified purposes -- so-called tied or specific-purpose grants.
General, or untied, grants last year were cut heavily but temporarily as a once-and-for-all contribution by the states to the federal government's fiscal problems.
Accordingly, little change to their projected levels is expected.
The federal and state governments also planned to discuss non-fiscal matters, including the question of how to deal with the High Court's recent extension of native title in the Wik case.
